description: Post-Earthquake Serviceability of RC Bridge Columns Using Visual Inspection is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Mostafa Tazarv, South Dakota State University (sdstate.edu). Past test databases included a mix of bridge and building, standard and substandard columns, and reported parameters that might not be consistent with current codes or required in a bridge design. To achieve the current project goals, it was necessary to collect test data specific to modern RC bridge columns. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: RC Columns, Modern Bridges, Experimental Data, Earthquake. Published 2021-09-30. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
